title: Triage result routing reads its spec

story.i_want_to: TriageVerdict to route outcomes, run screens and apply effects from triage@1
story.so_that: a :judge spec's result is handled by one routing path

rationale: TriageVerdict hard-codes @routes (triage_verdict.ex:148-166), its screens (Gate A, Gate B triage phase, the injection screen, criteria present, :971-1018, :653-876) and its effects (bind triage_dispatch_id, write the drafted story).

acceptance_criteria.description: TriageVerdict reads outcomes, screens and effects from the spec; screens and effects are code modules named by the spec from a closed set.

Over the existing triage_verdict test corpus, the transitions applied, the screen codes and the drafted-story rows are identical before and after; the old and new paths run side by side in the test until the old one is deleted.
Re-triage (escalated -> detected) still supersedes the story's triage dispatches (rerun: :supersede_on_retriage) and Gate A resets.

test_cases.name: routing equivalence
steps: replay every triage_verdict test fixture through both paths

test_cases.name: re-triage
steps: escalate, re-triage, resend the old verdict
